The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. It holds scrambled egg whites, or possibly a cooked egg white scramble, plus cantaloupe chunks.

Egg whites: the pile covers roughly 60% of the plate and is moderately thick. I estimate about 150 g. At roughly 52 kcal per 100 g, that is about 80 kcal.

Cantaloupe: I count about 8 chunks, around 20 g each, so about 130 g. At roughly 34 kcal per 100 g, that is about 45 kcal.

Total: about 280 g and about 125 kcal. The egg may be cooked with some oil or may include yolk, so I'll raise the estimate slightly to about 140 kcal.
